written, graphic or machine-readable form, including but not limited to current or projected
components, parts, software, hardware, technical and other data, research material,
inventions, discoveries, designs, drawings, concepts, procedures, uses of materials, ideas,
diagrams, marketing plans, brochures, photographs, processes, combinations, test
equipment, test data, specifications, operational data, models, prototypes, materials,
methods and techniques.

information that was in the public domain at the time it was disclosed; (b) information that
can be demonstrated by documentary evidence to have been known to the Receiving Party
at the time of disclosure with no obligation of confidence; and (c) information that becomes
known to the Receiving Party from a source other than the Disclosing Party, as
demonstrated by appropriate documentation, without breach of any obligation of
confidence by the Receiving Party; for the avoidance of doubt it is clarified and agreed that
